sentences.text: [2] The present petition has been filed by a person who claims to be purchaser of the acquired land vide two registered sale deeds dated 29.09.2016 and 15.04.2017, allegedly executed by the original owner, namely Atit Shivgiri Jagatgiri.

The land in question bearing Revenue Survey No.263 (Old Survey No.42 NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/6765/2023 ORDER DATED: 07/01/2025 undefined paiki 1) of village Zandi (Janadi), Taluka - Tharad, District - Banaskantha having residential plot Nos.1 to 12, 15 to 18 as well as 34 to 37.

It is sought to be submitted that the petitioner had purchased the land in question much prior to the initiation of the land acquisition proceedings under the National Highways Act, 1956 (hereinafter referred to as "the Act, 1956"), inasmuch as, the notification under Section 3A of the Act, 1956 was issued on 05.09.2018.
The petitioner has also objected to the land acquisition proceeding by filing objection on 03.10.2018.
[3] It is further submitted that though the petitioner had purchased the land in question and was owner and occupier at the time of acquisition but compensation was paid to the erstwhile owner.
It was contended that when this fact was pointed out, an order dated 06.08.2020 was passed by the competent authority which is appended as Annexure 'E' to the writ petition.
It is then stated that pursuant to the said order, the original owner, namely Atit Shivgiri Jagatgiri had re- deposited the said amount.

We may note, at this juncture, that neither the original owner is party to the writ petition nor there NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/6765/2023 ORDER DATED: 07/01/2025 undefined is anything on record which would substantiate that the original owner had re-deposited the compensation amount under the award pertaining to the land in question.
Apart from this, the reference to the communication dated 06.08.2020 as the order of the competent authority seems to be misleading.

A perusal of page '82' of the paper-book indicates that the said communication had been issued from the office of the competent authority, NHAI / Deputy Collector, Tharad, under the signature of the acquiring authority, the National Highway Authority of India / Sub-divisional Magistrate, Tharad.

entities.text: National Highway Authority of India / Sub-divisional Magistrate, Tharad
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The assertion therein with respect to the refund of compensation seems to be after grant of hearing to the persons interested in the land in question.

[4] Be that as it may, the communication dated 06.08.2020 appended at page '82' of the paper-book allegedly issued by the authority passing the award under Section 3g(1), cannot be treated as determination of claim of the petitioner of being entitled to disbursement of compensation.

We may also record that there is a complete silence in the writ petition about the mutation of the name of the petitioner in the revenue record NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/6765/2023 ORDER DATED:
07/01/2025 undefined and it seems that in the revenue records, the name of the original owner continued which has led to disbursement of compensation in his favour.
[5] Taking note of the above, we find that the prayers made by the petitioner in the present petition requires a factual inquiry.

We, therefore, relegate the petitioner to approach the competent authority NHAI, namely the Deputy Collector, Tharad, Banaskantha by filing a representation appending the documents for proof of his right, title and interest in land in question.

In case, such an application is filed along with the copy of this order within a period of two weeks from today, the competent authority would be required to make an inquiry by issuing notice and providing due opportunity to the original owner.

sentences.text: [6] The contention of the petitioner that the original owner had re-deposited the compensation amount after the order dated 06.08.2020 at page '82' of the paper-book shall also be examined by the competent authority.

The competent authority would be well within its jurisdiction to take a decision as to the NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/6765/2023 ORDER DATED: 07/01/2025 undefined entitlement of the petitioner for disbursement of compensation amount strictly in accordance with law and any observations made hereinabove will not come in the way of the parties,
in the matter of dispute raised before us.

[7] The competent authority shall be required to take a final decision, as expeditiously as possible,
preferable within a period of EIGHT WEEKS from the date of receipt of the application after providing due notice and opportunity of hearing to all persons concerned / interested in the land in question including the petitioner herein and the original owner.
[8] With the above observations and direction, the writ is hereby disposed of.

[9] Connected Civil Application stand disposed of.
(SUNITA AGARWAL, C.J.) (PRANAV TRIVEDI, J.)
